Name: Game Reminder v1.2
Author: mmanlapat
Description:
[size=4]Reminds the player of villagers birthday and to watch the cooking show via notification or letter.[/size]
[color=#cccccc][b][size=2]Configuration:[/size][/b][/color]
[b]"reminderTime": 600[/b] - [color=#d8d8d8][i]The time where the reminder shows up. Defaults to 6:00AM[/i][/color]
[b]"elapseDelay": 1[/b] - [color=#d8d8d8][i]If the time is right, this is the delay in seconds before showing notification. Defaults to 1[/i][/color]
[b]"useLetterNotification": false[/b][color=#cccccc] - [i]If true, notifications with be send via letter. Defaults to false[/i][/color]
[b]"playSound": true[/b][color=#cccccc] - [i]Play a sound. Defaults to true[/i][/color]
[b]"enableCookingRecipe": true[/b] - [color=#cccccc][i]Enable reminder if cooking show is on TV. Defaults to true[/i][/color]
[b]"enableBirthday": true[/b] - [color=#cccccc][i]Enable reminder if a villager celebrates his/her birthday. Defaults to true[/i][/color]
[b]"enableEvent": true[/b] - [color=#cccccc][i]Enable reminder for events and festivals. Defaults to true[/i][/color]

[b][size=3]Notes:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][color=#6fa8dc]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2+[/color].[/size][/b]
[*][size=2]Configurable via [font=Courier New][color=#6fa8dc]config.json[/color][/font] file.[/size]
[*]Please [b][color=#6fa8dc]ENDORSE[/color][/b] or [b][url=http://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=24NAGUZNEE4R8]Donate[/url][/b] if you like the mod. :D
[/list]
[b][size=3]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Latest version of [size=2][b][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url][/b][/size].
[*][size=2][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/size] 1.2+. (If you don't own the game, please consider buying it [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/Stardew_Valley/]here[/url])
[/list]
[b][size=3]Installation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to Stardew Valley installation folder.
[*]Open mod file and choose a file version. [color=#cccccc](If there are any)[/color]
[*]Extract the contents into [color=#6fa8dc][size=2][font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/size][/color]. [color=#cccccc](Updating) Remove\Replace any previous version of the mod.[/color]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Files:[/size][/b]
[list]

[/list]

[list]
